react.description:
A single slide inside a `Carousel`. Its width is driven by the carousel's
scroll position; it simply projects its children.

tags.devx: - Intended for use inside `Carousel`, which injects sizing and slide roles.
tags.a11y:
- Rendered by `Carousel` as a `group` with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and
  an `aria-label`; used standalone it is a plain container with no slide role.
tags.limitations:
- Sizing (`outputRange`) is provided by the parent `Carousel`; used on its own
  the item has no min/max width.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

outputRange.name: outputRange
outputRange.description: Min/max item width in px, provided by the parent `Carousel`.

angular.description:
A single slide inside a `lib-carousel`. Its width is driven by the
carousel's scroll position; it simply projects its content.

tags.devx: Intended for use inside `lib-carousel`, which stamps sizing and slide semantics on this component's host element.
tags.a11y: Rendered inside `lib-carousel` as a `group` with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and an accessible name; used standalone it is a plain container with no slide role.
tags.limitations: Sizing (`outputRange`) is provided by the parent carousel; used on its own the item has no min/max width.

outputRange.name: outputRange
outputRange.description: Min/max item width in px, provided by the parent `Carousel`.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.
